findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly. They can be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.
The ADTS stream changes at 0x1F7 from AAC LC, 44100 Hz, channel configuration 2 to AAC LC, 48000 Hz, channel configuration 2.
ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly. They can be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.
